value.target: net expected goals (provider xG for minus against) within horizon_s, team in possession

basis.x: x (m, attacking towards +x, goal centre at 52.5)
basis.goal_angle: angle between the posts seen from the point (rad)
basis.in_box: 1 inside the penalty area (|y| < 20.16 and x > 36), else 0

advice.score: p * V(target) + (1 - p) * (-V_opp(loss point)) - V(now); shot: xG - V(now)
